items.title: Bob Watts Interview, 1963-02-28
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...you were talking about your good friend Shorty... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, yeah, he ain't the good friend, man. Shorty knows, Shorty's bad.

ctx.x: Let's see, this is a reel for Bob Watts, February 28th, 1963. And you were talking about your good friend Shorty, who was that? Talking about Shorty?
Yeah, yeah, he ain't the good friend, man. Shorty knows, Shorty's bad. Shorty'll tell ya. Shorty'll tell ya.
